## Tools & Dashboards 🛠️

### [SIYA: Sistema de Indicadores de los YA](https://ninezya.org/siya/)
A **monitoring system** of childhood and adolescence indicators for the NiñezYA coalition, built as a collaborative team effort. I participated in **creating, constructing, extracting, and feeding the indicators** from multiple administrative and survey sources across three releases, and in documenting a [reproducible pipeline](https://github.com/dfmendivelso10/Ninez-YA).

### [Maternal and Child Health Dashboard](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/maternoinfantil/)
A **monitoring platform** tracking 22+ health indicators across 1,101 Colombian municipalities for Fundación Éxito, built as a collaborative team effort. I participated in **building the indicators** from large-scale administrative data, from extraction and cleaning to feeding the platform.

### [Prevalence and Nature of CSEA: Interactive Data Tool](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/especiales/prevalence-csea/)
An **interactive tool** on child sexual exploitation and abuse in 17 countries, built as a collaborative team effort. I participated in **extracting and harmonizing** the Violence Against Children and Youth Survey (VACS) microdata and feeding the tool with data and content.

## Working Papers & Publications 📝

### Intergenerational transmission of childhood adversity in Colombia
A **working paper in preparation** studying 163 caregiver–child dyads on how Adverse Childhood Experiences are transmitted to child socioemotional outcomes, using mediation analysis within a structural equation framework. I am a co-author at the IMAGINA Research Center.

### Prevalence and measurement of childhood adversity in Bogotá public services
A **working paper in preparation** on 346 adolescents and young adults across 18 localities, survey-weighted to represent 1.8M residents, introducing a participatory measurement instrument. I am a co-author at the IMAGINA Research Center.

### Prevalence and Nature of Child Sexual Exploitation and Abuse
A **technical report (in submission)** based on VACS microdata from 17 countries. I assembled and maintained the research datasets behind it.
